card.name: Majority quantifiers before a verb
card.fires_on: The last word of a subject phrase that states how many or what share of patients or cases are affected, such as 'more than 90%', 'many', or 'the great majority of mothers on ... medication'. The next word is expected to be a verb like 'will' or 'have'.

modes.label: Percent or share
modes.description: A percentage or fraction of cases or patients ends the subject, right before the verb.
modes.example: as many as one third may be born with this condition. Fortunately, more than 90<<%>> of all cases resolve by the time kids

modes.label: Many or most as subject
modes.description: 'many' or 'most' acts as the quantifier for a group of experts, patients or cases.
modes.example: with most<< cases>> occurring in pediatric patients ≤18 years

modes.label: Condition name ending a group subject
modes.description: The last piece of a disease or drug name ends a subject like 'most people with X' or 'children born with X'.
modes.example: However, most people with vitil<<igo>> have no other autoimmune disease.

card.writes: It lowers words meaning 'mostly', 'generally' and 'the majority', so the model is less likely to add another hedge after the subject.
card.plain: It marks the end of a phrase saying how many or what share of patients are affected, just before the verb.
